saw_lines: Bike buyers compare a few models, then check delivery and returns before paying, since a bike is hard to send back.
So the sale is lost on the page, when delivery and returns feel unclear, before the price even matters.
Your 3 live Meta ads show no proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Lead the next one with a review count or orders shipped.
ads_1: Proof-led video ads for your bike and kids lines, opening on a review count
